2123198838047735948.en_summary: ANTHROPIC OFFICIALLY PRICES ITS IPO AT $83 A SHARE AT $1.49T VALUATION. Anthropic $ANT sold 980 million shares to raise $81.34 billion, up from the 825 million it originally planned and above its $70-$78 range. About $79.4 billion goes to Anthropic. Existing shareholders selling 23.6 million shares get about $2 billion. Reuters calls it the biggest IPO ever, topping the $75 billion SpaceX raised in June before extra shares. If underwriters buy all 147 million extra shares in their 30-day option, the raise would reach $93.5 billion, passing SpaceX's $85.7 billion total. The price values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion fully diluted. With a $26 billion private placement from investors including Nvidia, Microsoft and Google, it will have more than $200 billion on its balance sheet, per the FT. Shares start trading Thursday on Nasdaq.
2123198838047735948.zh_summary: ANTHROPIC正式將其IPO定價為每股83美元，估值1.49萬億美元。Anthropic ANT出售9.8億股籌集813.4億美元，高於原計劃的8.25億股及70-78美元區間。約794億美元歸Anthropic。現有股東出售2360萬股獲得約20億美元。路透稱這是有史以來最大IPO，超過SpaceX在6月額外股份前籌集的750億美元。若承銷商行使30天期權購買全部1.47億額外股份，籌集將達935億美元，超過SpaceX總計857億美元。該定價使Anthropic完全稀釋估值約1.5萬億美元。加上包括英偉達、微軟及谷歌在內投資者的260億美元私募，根據FT，其資產負債表上將有超過2000億美元。股份周四在納斯達克開始交易。
